description: Interface defining factory methods for creating stream objects in PSR-7 HTTP message implementation.

classes.name: StreamFactoryInterface
classes.description: Defines methods for creating stream objects from strings, files, or resources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream from a string content, optionally using a temporary resource.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing file or stream URI, specifying the mode to open it.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing PHP resource.
